conversation_controls_human_owner_ck.name: conversation_controls_human_owner_ck
conversation_controls_human_owner_ck.value: "conversation_controls"."owner_mode" <> 'HUMAN_ACTIVE' or "conversation_controls"."owner_staff_id" is not null or "conversation_controls"."owner_external_user_id" is not null

brand_identity_keys_material_ck.name: brand_identity_keys_material_ck
brand_identity_keys_material_ck.value: ("brand_identity_keys"."alg" = 'HS256' and "brand_identity_keys"."secret_id" is not null) or ("brand_identity_keys"."alg" <> 'HS256' and "brand_identity_keys"."public_jwk" is not null)

agent_versions_published_ck.name: agent_versions_published_ck
agent_versions_published_ck.value: "agent_versions"."state" = 'draft' or ("agent_versions"."config_hash" is not null and "agent_versions"."published_at" is not null)

kill_switches_target_ck.name: kill_switches_target_ck
kill_switches_target_ck.value:
("kill_switches"."scope" = 'tenant' and "kill_switches"."brand_id" is null and "kill_switches"."agent_id" is null)
        or ("kill_switches"."scope" = 'brand' and "kill_switches"."brand_id" is not null and "kill_switches"."agent_id" is null)
        or ("kill_switches"."scope" = 'agent' and "kill_switches"."agent_id" is not null)
